fields.title: 📖 Ḥayāʾ belongs to īmān
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said, or transmitted:

> ***“Ḥayāʾ is a branch of īmān.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True shame holds one back from what is ugly and makes the heart more alert. Whoever loses ḥayāʾ loses a protective wall of faith.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī und Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim; Überlieferung von Abū Hurayrah.
